$comment: Pinned reference emulator of the benchmark: upstream QEMU system mode as built by Debian 13, run as an external process in the container image built from qemu/Dockerfile (base image and Debian snapshot pinned there). Nothing of it is linked into, vendored by or redistributed with this repository. License: GPL-2.0 (QEMU), used as a test oracle only. tools/run.py refuses an image whose qemu-system-arm differs from binarySha256. An image rebuilt from the Dockerfile has another image id than the one the published record names; the binary is what is pinned.
name: qemu-system-arm
